hints.sex: Changes the BMR formula and the safe calorie floor.
hints.birthDate: Age feeds the calculation and stays current on its own.
hints.height: Used in the basal metabolic rate calculation.
hints.startWeight: The baseline for progress — your weight when the diary started.
hints.targetWeight: The goal: drives the remaining kilos and the progress percentage.
hints.startedAt: The date the diary counts from.
hints.activity: Multiplies the basal rate: the higher it is, the more you burn per day.
hints.deficit: How far below your expenditure to eat. 500 kcal is roughly 0.5 kg a week.
hints.proteinPerKg: Protein per kilogram of body weight. 1.6-2.2 g protects muscle while losing weight; 1.8 is a safe middle.
hints.proteinBasis: Current weight suits most cases. Target weight is for noticeable excess weight, where counting from the current one inflates the protein figure.
hints.fatPercent: Share of calories from fat; 20-35% is the usual range. Whatever is left after protein and fat becomes carbs.
